5 Excel tricks
for when the boss
wants the numbers
by 5.

slides.b: Insert, PivotTable. Drag a column to Rows and the amount to Values. A summary in ten seconds.
=SUMIFS(amount, region, "Nairobi") adds only the rows you ask for, and updates itself.
Pull a price or a name from another sheet by its code. No more copying across by eye.
Home, Conditional Formatting, Top 10. The numbers the boss will ask about light up.
Page Layout, Fit to 1 page wide. Nobody wants column H on page three.

Tell Toso what the numbers are for. Get it finished in Excel, totals and summary done.
Pay with M-Pesa. No card, no monthly bill.
